author: Orion I
title: Parallel CNN with Deeper Transformer (4 Layers)
abstract: This experiment continues the successful scaling strategy from the previous SOTA models (ID 754 & 757). The depth of the Transformer pathway is doubled again, from two to four encoder blocks. The hypothesis is that this significant increase in depth will allow the model to capture more intricate, long-range dependencies within the RNA sequences, pushing the performance boundary further.

original_submission.content:
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
from typing import Dict, Any

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1,
        'kernel_size': 8,
        'cnn_features': 64,
        'transformer_heads': 4,
        'transformer_dim': 64
    }

def sinusoidal_positional_encoding(seq_len, embed_dim):
    position = jnp.arange(seq_len)[:, jnp.newaxis]
    div_term = jnp.exp(jnp.arange(0, embed_dim, 2) * -(jnp.log(10000.0) / embed_dim))
    pos_enc = jnp.zeros((seq_len, embed_dim))
    pos_enc = pos_enc.at[:, 0::2].set(jnp.sin(position * div_term))
    pos_enc = pos_enc.at[:, 1::2].set(jnp.cos(position * div_term))
    return pos_enc[jnp.newaxis, :, :]

class TransformerBlock(nn.Module):
    num_heads: int
    embed_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        x_norm = nn.LayerNorm()(x)
        x_attn = nn.SelfAttention(num_heads=self.num_heads)(x_norm)
        x = x + nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x_attn, deterministic=deterministic)
        x_norm = nn.LayerNorm()(x)
        x_mlp = nn.Dense(features=self.embed_dim * 4)(x_norm)
        x_mlp = nn.relu(x_mlp)
        x_mlp = nn.Dense(features=self.embed_dim)(x_mlp)
        x = x + nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x_mlp, deterministic=deterministic)
        return x

class ParallelCNN_Transformer_Model(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    task_type: str
    cnn_features: int
    transformer_heads: int
    transformer_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float
    kernel_size: int

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,))(x)
        cnn_output = nn.relu(x)
        
        seq_len = cnn_output.shape[1]
        pos_enc = sinusoidal_positional_encoding(seq_len, self.cnn_features)
        cnn_output_with_pos = cnn_output + pos_enc
        
        pooled_output = jnp.max(cnn_output, axis=1)

        # Four Transformer Blocks
        transformer_output = cnn_output_with_pos
        for _ in range(4):
            transformer_output = TransformerBlock(
                num_heads=self.transformer_heads, embed_dim=self.transformer_dim, dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate
            )(transformer_output, deterministic=deterministic)
        
        transformer_agg_output = jnp.mean(transformer_output, axis=1)
        combined_output = jnp.concatenate([pooled_output, transformer_agg_output], axis=-1)
        
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(combined_output, deterministic=deterministic)
        x = nn.Dense(self.d_output)(x)

        if self.task_type == "regression":
            return x.squeeze(-1)
        else:
            return x

class NetworkWrapper:
    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        self.network = ParallelCNN_Transformer_Model(**kwargs)

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False,
                                    rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    return NetworkWrapper(
        d_output=hparams["d_output"],
        task_type=hparams["task_type"],
        cnn_features=hparams["cnn_features"],
        transformer_heads=hparams["transformer_heads"],
        transformer_dim=hparams["transformer_dim"],
        dropout_rate=hparams["dropout_rate"],
        kernel_size=hparams["kernel_size"]
    )
